sources.title: tipsv2-b14: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview tipsv2-b14 is a contrastive vision-language model developed by google that produces spatially rich image features aligned with text embeddings. This Base variant contains 86M vision parameters and 110M text parameters, with an embedding dimension of 768, and uses a ViT vision encoder (12 layers) paired with a Transformer text encoder (12 layers).
